appDesc.message: Nook, your Mac assistant, in your browser: ask about the page you are on, and let Nook read and act in your tabs once you approve.

setupStep2.message: Go to Settings › Editor & browser › Nook in your browser and click Connect.

setupStep3.message: Come back here: the panel connects by itself.

siteRestricted.message: The browser keeps its own pages to itself; Nook cannot read or use them.

siteAllowed.message: Nook may read and work on this site when you ask.

siteBlocked.message: Off for this site: Nook will not read or touch it.

pausedNote.message: Paused: Nook does not read or act in this browser until you resume.

intro.message: Ask Nook about this page, or ask it to do something here. Nook does it step by step and asks you here before it clicks, types or opens anything.

onMacNote.message: Waiting for you in Nook on your Mac.

noBrain.message: Nook has no model yet. Choose one in Nook › Settings › Assistant.

errorGeneric.message: Nook could not answer. Is Nook running on your Mac?

presenceWorking.message: Nook is working in this tab

presenceBlocked.message: Nook is working here; your clicks wait until it is done. Esc stops Nook.

presenceSignIn.message: Sign in on this page; Nook goes on by itself once you are in.

modelChip.message: Choose the model Nook thinks with

suggestNext.message: What should I do next here?

chatsEmpty.message: Chats you start here show up in this list.

commandPick.message: Select an element on the page and copy it for your coding agent

pickTitle.message: Select an element to copy for your agent (Alt+Shift+E)

pickPdfTitle.message: Select a spot in the PDF to copy for your agent (Alt+Shift+E)

pickStarted.message: Click an element on the page (or a spot in a PDF). Esc stops.

pickCopied.message: Copied $1: paste it in your agent's prompt

pickElementHint.message: Click an element to copy it for your agent · Shift-click for more · Esc stops

pickElementMore.message: $1 selected · Shift-click for more · Return copies

pickPointHint.message: Click a spot in the PDF to copy it for your agent · Esc stops

pickNotCopied.message: The browser did not allow copying. Click on the page once and try again.

pickRestricted.message: The browser does not let extensions select on this page.

pickFileAccess.message: For files on your computer, turn on "Allow access to file URLs" in this extension's details.

pickFailed.message: Selecting did not work. Reload the page and try again.

trustSwitch.message: Let Nook act on $1 without asking

trustOn.message: Nook clicks and types here without asking first. Paying, sending and deleting still ask.

trustOff.message: Nook asks here before each click and each text it types.

approvalUnnamed.message: Take a step on this page

approvalFinal.message: This can't be undone: it may pay, send, delete or book something.
